management.initial_revoke: enabled:false may issue first operator cookie before diagnostics
management.enable: prior diagnostic cookie/nonce plus API check; reload config and revalidate request cancellation, nonce, selected context, namespace and private client identity under lock after checks

context_loading.implementation: client-go default KUBECONFIG multi-file merge, default kubeconfig, noninteractive explicit context overrides, in-cluster fallback
context_loading.effective_default_namespace: kubeconfig namespace or default; in-cluster POD_NAMESPACE or ServiceAccount namespace file or default
context_loading.cache: bounded128 name references; unchanged credential/API fingerprint reuses client; file/credential/TLS changes invalidate opaque client identity

origin_boundary.same_origin: exact actual HTTP/TLS scheme plus Host/port, reject opaque Origin, userinfo, path/query/fragment
origin_boundary.sec_fetch_site: cross-site rejected even if Origin missing
origin_boundary.json: exact parsed application/json, one bounded JSON value; reject form/text masquerading
origin_boundary.reverse_proxy: forwarded host/proto not trusted; TLS-terminating reverse proxies are not implicitly supported; Vite changeOrigin=false

portforward.preserved: real HTML HTTP preview and raw SPDY transport
portforward.response_isolation: CSP sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms; no allow-same-origin; no upstream Set-Cookie/CORS
portforward.ownership: list/read/close bound to operator cookie; revoke and scope change close sessions

errors.never_expose: raw config, tokens, API URL credentials, cert/private-key material, exec plugin stderr, rejected Secret values
